_source: printer.gcode.help on a U1 running multiACE

macros.ACEB__LOAD_0: Switch to ACE 0 and load all filled slots
macros.ACEB__LOAD_1: Switch to ACE 1 and load all filled slots
macros.ACEB__LOAD_2: Switch to ACE 2 and load all filled slots
macros.ACEB__LOAD_3: Switch to ACE 3 and load all filled slots
macros.ACEC__UNLOAD_ALL: Unload all toolheads that have filament
macros.ACEC__UNLOAD_T0: Unload T0 back to its ACE
macros.ACEC__UNLOAD_T1: Unload T1 back to its ACE
macros.ACEC__UNLOAD_T2: Unload T2 back to its ACE
macros.ACEC__UNLOAD_T3: Unload T3 back to its ACE
macros.ACED__DRY_START_0: Start drying on ACE 0 (uses config temp/duration)
macros.ACED__DRY_START_1: Start drying on ACE 1 (uses config temp/duration)
macros.ACED__DRY_START_2: Start drying on ACE 2 (uses config temp/duration)
macros.ACED__DRY_START_3: Start drying on ACE 3 (uses config temp/duration)
macros.ACEF__MODE_NORMAL: Switch to Normal mode (stock feeders, no ACE)
macros.ACEG__STATUS: Show active ACE, detected devices, and head mapping
macros.ACEH__UPDATE_APPLY: Download + install the latest multiACE release
macros.ACEH__UPDATE_CHECK: Check GitHub for a newer multiACE release (no install)
macros.ACE_BG_MOVE: [EXPERIMENTAL] Move a PARKED head's extruder without stalling the print. ACE_BG_MOVE HEAD=0-3 DISTANCE=<+-mm> [VELOCITY=5] [ACCEL=100] [FORCE=0]. Refuses the active extruder; FORCE=1 skips the cold-extrude check. No toolchange interlock yet - keep the head docked while it runs.
macros.ACE_BG_SET_HEAD: [multiACE] Declare a head bg-swap capable (= its dock is OPEN below, the cold-pull purges through it). ACE_BG_SET_HEAD HEAD=n ENABLE=0|1 - write-through: writes the [ace_bg_swap] heads config line (PERSIST=0 = until restart).
macros.ACE_BG_SWAP: [EXPERIMENTAL] Background SWAP of a PARKED ACE head: unload (if loaded), then feed+grip+prime the target slot through the OPEN dock - the arrival toolchange becomes a no-op. ACE_BG_SWAP HEAD=0-3 SLOT=0-3 [ACE=n] [TEMP=] [ANTI_OOZE=] [QUIET=1] [FORCE=1]. Same requirements as ACE_BG_UNLOAD.
macros.ACE_BG_UNLOAD: [EXPERIMENTAL] Unload a PARKED ACE head in the background (heat + cold-pull via bg moves + ACE retract) while printing. ACE_BG_UNLOAD HEAD=0-3 [TEMP=<feed temp>]. Requires head mode, 1:1 wiring, an OPEN dock below the head (purges ~60mm!), and the head must stay docked for the whole ~3min sequence.
macros.ACE_CALIBRATION_CANCEL: [multiACE] Stop and cancel the active calibration
macros.ACE_CALIBRATION_FEED: [multiACE] Feed a prepared calibration path to its toolhead sensor
macros.ACE_CALIBRATION_RETURN: [multiACE] Return from the splitter checkpoint to the ACE preload reference
macros.ACE_CALIBRATION_START: [multiACE] Start Bowden calibration. ACE_CALIBRATION_START ACE=0 SLOT=0 HEAD=0 SCOPE=ace|slot
macros.ACE_CLEAR_HEADS: [multiACE] Clear head-to-ACE/slot mapping and display info. Usage: ACE_CLEAR_HEADS [HEAD=0]
macros.ACE_DEBUG: [multiACE] Toggle state audit + telemetry + wiggle logging. Usage: ACE_DEBUG [ENABLE=0|1]
macros.ACE_DRY: [multiACE] Start drying on ACE. Usage: ACE_DRY ACE=0 [TEMP=] [DURATION=]
macros.ACE_DWELL_TEST: [multiACE] Test V2 mode=3 routing with varying dwells between stop and mode=3. Usage: ACE_DWELL_TEST [ACE=2] [SLOT=2] [DWELLS=50,100,250,500,1000,2000]
macros.ACE_FA_TEST: [multiACE] Stress-test FA stop+start across slots without a print. Usage: ACE_FA_TEST [ACE=0] [SCENARIO=cycle|pingpong|burst|matrix] [SLOTS=0,1,2,3] [DELAY=0.5] [REPEATS=2] [INTER=0] [RETRIES=0] [RETRY_DELAY=0.2]
macros.ACE_FEED: Feeds filament from ACE: ACE_FEED INDEX=<slot> LENGTH=<mm> [SPEED=<mm/s>] [ACE=<n>]. Without ACE= the active unit.
macros.ACE_FW_RELEASE: [multiACE] Release one ACE 2 serial port for a firmware flash (ACE=n)
macros.ACE_FW_RESUME: [multiACE] Reconnect an ACE released with ACE_FW_RELEASE (ACE=n)
macros.ACE_HEAD_STATUS: [multiACE] Show active ACE, detected devices, and head-to-ACE/slot mapping
macros.ACE_LIST: List all detected ACE devices (up to 4)
macros.ACE_LOAD_HEAD: [multiACE] Load a toolhead from ACE. Usage: ACE_LOAD_HEAD HEAD=0 [ACE=0] [SLOT=0]
macros.ACE_MULTI_SLOT_TEST: [multiACE] Test V2 multi-slot FA + concurrent transport (background-preload scenario). Usage: ACE_MULTI_SLOT_TEST [ACE=2] [FA_SLOT=2] [XPORT_SLOT=0] [XPORT_LEN=30] [XPORT_SPEED=20]
macros.ACE_PICKUP_CLEAN: [multiACE] Short nozzle wipe at the discard position after a bare-T tool pickup (HEAD=n). No-op unless Pickup-Cleaning is enabled. The preflight stamps this after picks that have no other cleaning move.
macros.ACE_PRELOAD: [multiACE] Preload heads from a UI-built plan. Same syntax as ACE_SEQ but UNLOAD defaults to 0 (no final unload).
macros.ACE_RAW_PROBE: [multiACE] DIAGNOSTIC: dump everything a unit reports for a slot, including fields the decoder normally drops. Works on V1 and V2. Usage: ACE_RAW_PROBE [ACE=n] [SLOT=n] [RFID_TEST=1]
macros.ACE_RETRACT: Retracts filament back to ACE: ACE_RETRACT INDEX=<slot> LENGTH=<mm> [SPEED=<mm/s>] [ACE=<n>]. Without ACE= the active unit.
macros.ACE_RUN_MODE_SWITCH: [multiACE] Switch mode: normal (stock), single (one ACE), multi (multi-ACE)
macros.ACE_SEQ: [multiACE] Run scripted load/unload sequence. PLAN: 0:1=load HEAD:ACE, A0=all from ACE, U=unload all, U0=unload head. UNLOAD=0|1 (default 1) runs final ACE_UNLOAD_ALL_HEADS.
macros.ACE_SET_AUTO_DRY: [multiACE] Humidity-controlled drying per ACE 2, live + persist
macros.ACE_SET_CONFIRM_COMMANDS: [multiACE] Toggle web load/unload confirmation (ENABLE=0|1), live + persist
macros.ACE_SET_HEAD_ACE: [multiACE] Set which ACE feeds an ACE head (head mode). Usage: ACE_SET_HEAD_ACE HEAD=0..3 ACE=0..3. Each ACE head is wired to exactly one ACE and can only load/swap that ACE's slots. Persisted.
macros.ACE_SET_HEAD_FEEDER: [multiACE] Toggle stock-feeder mode for a head (head mode only). Usage: ACE_SET_HEAD_FEEDER HEAD=0..3 ENABLE=0|1. When enabled the head loads/unloads via its stock side feeder and the ACE never touches it; when disabled the head is ACE-driven. Persisted.
macros.ACE_SET_HEAD_MANUAL: [multiACE] Toggle manual/TPU bypass for a head. Usage: ACE_SET_HEAD_MANUAL HEAD=0..3 ENABLE=0|1. When enabled: no ACE feed/retract/feed-assist/RFID for that head (load it by hand; the head sensor stays active). Persisted.
macros.ACE_SET_PURGE: [multiACE] Set the swap/load flush length (mm) for the next flush(es). Usage: ACE_SET_PURGE LENGTH=<mm>  or  ACE_SET_PURGE RESET=1 to fall back to the swap_purge_length config value. MATRIX=0|1 ignores/honors the per-pair LENGTH stamps the preflight writes from the slicer flush matrix - MATRIX=0 = fixed swap_purge_length for every flush. Writes the purge_matrix config line (write-through); MATRIX=..  PERSIST=0 = RAM only, the config value returns at restart. Intended for multiACE Pro to set per-colour-pair purge from the slicer. LENGTH=0 = use the stock default (80mm).
macros.ACE_SET_QUAD_REPLENISH: [multiACE] Toggle Quad Replenish (ENABLE=0|1): on a runout stock cannot serve, auto-reload the head from a slot with the same declared identity and RESUME. Live + write-through (writes the quad_replenish config line; PERSIST=0 = until restart). FIRST=0|1 sets the order vs stock: 1 (default) = drain the head OWN lane first (reaches more spools, keeps the sliced head layout, costs a reload per spool), 0 = stock head-switch first (instant, but rewrites the tool mapping for the rest of the print); write-through like ENABLE (quad_first config line).
macros.ACE_SET_SPOOLMAN: [multiACE] Spoolman url / auto-sync (URL=, AUTO=0|1), live + persist
macros.ACE_SPOOL_ADD: [multiACE] Add a spool to the local table: ACE_SPOOL_ADD MATERIAL=PLA [COLOR=RRGGBB] [VENDOR=..] [SUBTYPE=..] [WEIGHT=1000] [DENSITY=..] [LABEL=..] [SKU=..] [SPOOLMAN_ID=..] [ACE=n SLOT=n]. WEIGHT is the filament weight in grams (net, without the core); with ACE+SLOT the new spool is bound to that slot right away.
macros.ACE_SPOOL_ASSIGN: [multiACE] Bind a spool to a slot: ACE_SPOOL_ASSIGN ACE=n SLOT=n [ID=n], or to a feeder/manual head: ACE_SPOOL_ASSIGN HEAD=n [ID=n]. Without ID the binding is CLEARED (spool taken out - the entry keeps its remaining weight for when it comes back).
macros.ACE_SPOOL_DELETE: [multiACE] Remove a spool from the table: ACE_SPOOL_DELETE ID=n [FORCE=1]. A spool still bound to a slot is refused unless FORCE=1 (which also clears the binding).
macros.ACE_SPOOL_IMPORT: [multiACE] Restore/merge a spool table from a JSON file: ACE_SPOOL_IMPORT PATH=/tmp/spools.json [MODE=merge|replace]. merge (default) appends the file entries under FRESH ids and keeps the current table (slot bindings of the imported entries are dropped - they describe the other machine state); replace swaps the whole table incl. bindings. The previous table stays as <file>.bak.
macros.ACE_SPOOL_LIST: [multiACE] Show the local spool table (remaining weight is an ESTIMATE from extruded length, not a scale).
macros.ACE_SPOOL_SET: [multiACE] Edit a spool: ACE_SPOOL_SET ID=n [WEIGHT=..] [MATERIAL=..] [COLOR=..] [VENDOR=..] [SUBTYPE=..] [DENSITY=..] [LABEL=..] [SKU=..] [RESET_USED=1]. WEIGHT corrects the remaining grams (the value is an estimate, so correcting it against a scale is normal).
macros.ACE_STOP_DRYING: [multiACE] Stop ACE Pro dryer. Usage: ACE_STOP_DRYING [ACE=N]
macros.ACE_SWAP_HEAD: [multiACE] Mid-print filament swap. Usage: ACE_SWAP_HEAD HEAD=0 ACE=1 [SLOT=0]
macros.ACE_SWITCH: Switch active ACE unit. Usage: ACE_SWITCH TARGET=0 [AUTOLOAD=1]
macros.ACE_TEST: [multiACE] Run load/unload test. PLAN items (comma-sep): 0:1=load HEAD:ACE, H0:1=swap HEAD to ACE, A0=all from ACE, U=unload all, U0..U3=unload head, S0..S3=switch ACE, W5=wait 5s
macros.ACE_TEST_CANCEL: [multiACE] Cancel a running ACE_TEST after current step
macros.ACE_TIPFORM_RELOAD: [multiACE] Re-read the [ace_tipform] section from ace.cfg and apply it live (no Klipper restart). Usage: ACE_TIPFORM_RELOAD [FILE=<path>]
macros.ACE_UNLOAD_ALL_CANCEL: [multiACE] Cancel a running ACE_UNLOAD_ALL_HEADS after the current toolhead
macros.ACE_UNLOAD_ALL_HEADS: [multiACE] Unload all toolheads that have filament loaded
macros.ACE_UNLOAD_HEAD: [multiACE] Unload a toolhead back to its ACE. Usage: ACE_UNLOAD_HEAD HEAD=0 [RETRACT_LENGTH=<mm>] [KEEP_HEAT=<temp>] [CALIBRATION_PREPARE=1 ACE=0 SLOT=0]
macros.ACE_UPDATE_APPLY: [multiACE] Download + install the latest release. Optional FORCE=1 reinstalls even if already on latest.
macros.ACE_UPDATE_CHECK: [multiACE] Check GitHub for a newer release (no install)
